name: The Public Domain
about: Music and speech off records from 1925 and before. Each New Year's Day another year of them goes free.

name: Readings
about: Captain Johnson's General History of the Pyrates, The Pirates Own Book and Treasure Island, read aloud chapter by chapter.

name: Netlabel
about: Electronic, ambient and experimental records their makers set free under Creative Commons. Ambient alone through the small hours.

name: Poets' Corner
about: Blake, Dickinson, Shelley, Owen and over a hundred more poets, read aloud. Nobody owns a word of it.

name: Shanties
about: Shanties, sea songs and pirate songs off 78s, field recordings and Navy band records, every one free to air.

name: Contraband
about: Books that kings, censors and courts tried to stop, read aloud round the clock. Milton, Paine, Voltaire, Douglass, Thoreau, Goldman.
